verdict.rationale: Cursor has a marketplace for plugins, skills, MCPs and rules, with one-click "Add to Cursor" installs and OAuth, so third-party extensions can be pulled into agent workflows. Automations can start from Marketplace templates, and hooks can load from third-party tools like Claude Code. However, the evidence mostly shows third-party tools, extensions and integrations; the only packaged agents named (Bugbot, Security Agents, PR Routing) are Cursor-managed, not partner-built agent apps. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of partner-built agent apps in the marketplace, docs on installing and governing them as workflow agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
